text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, after scaling the mountain of
paperwork
on my desk for days on end,
it's all done...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's when Mejiro Bright comes in
for a
meeting...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me, Trainer, but you appear
rather
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You've been holed up in this office quite
a lot
lately, and frankly, I'm starting to
worry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's wonderful news!
Congratulations! ♪
choice_data_list: 仕事はもう片づけたから大丈夫！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You deserve to be rewarded for all of
your hard
work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, of course! Might I interest you in a
picnic on
academy grounds on our next
day off?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The weather has been so nice recently.
I'm quite
sure you'll have a relaxing time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee, then it's settled. ♪ Allow me to
handle
all the preparation on the day of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You needn't bring anything, Trainer.
Your
presence will be plenty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day I'm having a picnic with
Mejiro
Bright. I head to the designated
meeting place
and spot her unfolding a
big plastic sheet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: One, two! Whew, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, greetings, Trainer. It's already time
for our
picnic, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've just finished laying down a sheet for
us to sit
on. Everything's almost ready,
just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Dear me. What was the next step
again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, yes! Setting our places for tea. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, I need to take the saucers out of
the basket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Clatter... Clatter... Clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, a strong gust of wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwip, fwip, fwip...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me! The sheet I set out has
been blown
away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I shall go and retrieve it at once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
While I appreciate the thought, Trainer,
today is
for you to put your feet up and
relax.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't lift a finger. I shall be back
in a
moment. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do as Mejiro Bright tells me and wait
for her to
finish the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a way only she can, Mejiro Bright goes
all out
in her efforts to set up our picnic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A kind lady at the cafeteria prepared
this lovely
fruit platter for us to share.
Do help yourself. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Dear me, wherever did I stow the
paring knife?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle, rustle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And here's our tea. Dober shared some
of her
favorite blend with us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first, the leaves go into the
pot...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swish... Swish...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter the task at hand, Mejiro
Bright moves
at a slow and steady pace.
That said, watching
her work is calming
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! A decorative flower would
make this
quite the pretty picnic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I shall go and find one. Please
be patient
for just a little while longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I realize that I'm now so relaxed that I
can
actually feel the stress of the daily
grind fading
away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Things took a little longer to arrange
than
originally planned, but how did you
find today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! Well, I'm truly delighted to have
been of
assistance. ♪
choice_data_list: とてもゆっくりできたよ！
明日からまた頑張れそう！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I believe that the busier people become,
the
more they tend to suppress their
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And it's precisely at times like those
when it's best
to slow down and take
things easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've learned something very
important
from Mejiro Bright today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. If you feel refreshed, then
today was a
great success.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the goal for which we both
strive remains
some distance away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep focused and proceed with
caution at
our own pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've learned something very
important
from Mejiro Bright today.
